home.ctaTitle: Ready to consult with a specialist?
home.ctaText: Online booking takes under two minutes. No waiting on hold, no paperwork.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Use our online booking: choose a department and doctor, pick an available time, and enter your details. You can also call or message us on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to book?
faqs.a: No — you can book as a guest. A free account lets you see upcoming and past visits and your medical history in the patient portal.

faqs.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.a: Log in to your patient portal to cancel an upcoming appointment, or message our front desk and we'll help you reschedule.

faqs.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
faqs.a: Coverage depends on your plan. Please contact us with your insurance details before your visit and we'll confirm for you.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.a: Please bring a photo ID (Emirates ID or passport), your insurance card if you have one, a list of current medications, and any recent test results or reports.
